questions.title: How do I place an order?
questions.content: To place an order, simply browse our product selection, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Follow the on-screen instructions to enter your shipping and payment information. You'll receive an order confirmation email once your order is successfully placed.

questions.title: Can I cancel my order?
questions.content: Order cancellations are possible if the order has not yet been processed or shipped. Please contact our customer support team as soon as possible with your order number to request a cancellation.

questions.title: How do I track my order?
questions.content: Once your order has shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing a tracking number. You can use this number to track your package in the website. You can also use the tracking number to check the status of your order.

questions.title: How long does shipping take?
questions.content: JuanPasabuy PH uses a padala-style shipping service designed for those who are willing to wait for authentic products delivered from Dubai. Shipping times vary depending on your location and the logistics schedule. Estimated arrival date will be posted on your Order Status page in the website.

questions.title: What are the shipping costs?
questions.content: Shipping fees are already included in the product price, no surprises at checkout.

questions.title: What is your return policy?
questions.content: We accept returns on most items within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, and in resalable condition. Some exclusions may apply (e.g., final sale items). Please refer to our full return policy for detailed information.

questions.title: What is the return process?
questions.content: To initiate a return, please contact our customer support team with your order number and provide the necessary documentation. We will guide you through the return process and assist you in returning the item to its original condition. Please note that the return process may vary depending on the carrier and the item's origin.

questions.title: How long does it take to process a return?
questions.content: Once we receive your returned item(s), please allow 15 business days for processing. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method. You will receive an email notification once your return has been processed and your refund has been issued.
